title: Appointment reminder consumer with at-least-once delivery
name: Appointment reminder consumer

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this consumer handles redelivered or failed reminder messages? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The process crashes right after sms.send succeeds but before the UPDATE runs. What happens next?
choices: The message is lost because it was already acked
The broker redelivers it; reminder_sent_at is still null, so send is called again with the same idempotency key and the provider does not send a second SMS
The patient receives two SMS messages
The message goes to a dead-letter queue immediately

questions.prompt: Why is the idempotency key derived from appointmentId rather than from msg.messageId?
choices: If the producer publishes two different messages for the same appointment, both resolve to the same key, so the patient still gets one reminder
It makes the UPDATE statement faster

questions.prompt: What is the effect of `prefetch(10)` combined with manual acks here?
choices: At most 10 unacked messages are in flight to this consumer, bounding concurrent handlers and the amount redelivered if it crashes
Each message is retried at most 10 times
Messages are processed strictly in order
The consumer acks in batches of 10
